_comment: Agent UUID -> canonical git commit identity (GOL-2986).
The UUID is the agent's Paperclip id, surfaced to every agent run as
$PAPERCLIP_AGENT_ID. agent-identity.mjs uses this map to claim a per-worktree
git identity and to assert at commit time that the acting agent is the commit
author -- the git author facet is what the PR-review self-review guard reads
Convention: <first-name>@goldberrygrove.farm, name = the agent's board name.
KEEP `name`/`email` IN SYNC with the github-sync plugin config field
prReviewAuthorIdentities for any agent that is also a PR reviewer (ada, iris) --
a name/email that is not in that list defeats the self-review skip.
An agent id that is absent here fails SAFE: no assertion, no claim, commit
`neutral` is the non-agent identity a shared .git/config is reset to when it is
found carrying some agent's address: it must stay a real, resolvable identity
(an empty one makes `git commit` die with 128 before any hook can help).
